Playbook.name: Defender — User Flagged by Multiple Defender Products - SOC Playbook

ExecutiveSummary.Overview: One user was flagged by multiple Defender products (e.g. Endpoint AND Identity AND Office) in the window (ES|QL) - cross-surface corroboration of a compromised user. Triage: a genuinely compromised user across surfaces, or coincidental unrelated alerts?
ExecutiveSummary.BusinessImpact: A user flagged across endpoint, identity and office surfaces is strong evidence of account compromise.

TelemetryRequirements.Requirement: Defender XDR alerts via Elastic Agent (verified live). Fields: m365_defender.alert.detection_source, .severity, .status, .title, .category, threat.tactic.name, user.name, host.name, m365_defender.alert.evidence.device_dns_name. INGEST LAG ~26 min - 4h windows + event.ingested override.

Signal.Name: User Flagged by Multiple Defender Produc
Signal.Details: user with alerts from multiple Defender products.

InitialAssessment.Rule: Weigh the full evidence story per the ClassificationGuidance, not any single fact.

Investigation.Goal: Determine whether the multi-product flags corroborate a compromised user or are coincidental.

Step.name: Defender products and alerts flagging the user
Step.Purpose: The set of products and alert titles shows whether the flags form a coherent attack story on one user.
Step.Query: FROM logs-m365_defender.alert* | WHERE user.name == "$user" AND @timestamp >= NOW() - 4 hours | KEEP @timestamp, m365_defender.alert.detection_source, m365_defender.alert.title, threat.tactic.name | SORT @timestamp DESC | LIMIT 25
Step.AnalystNotes: Endpoint (malware) + Identity (anomalous logon) + Office (mail rule) on one user in a short window = a coherent compromise. Unrelated benign alerts from different products spread over time are coincidental.

Node.Condition: A coherent multi-surface attack story on the user (e.g. malware -> identity anomaly -> mail rule).
Node.Result: True Positive (Compromised User - IR, reset + isolate)

Node.Condition: Coincidental, unrelated benign alerts from different products.
Multiple tuned/expected alerts for a special-purpose account.

DocumentationChecklist.Item: Attach outputs of INV-01-DEFUSER-PRODUCTS to the case.

SOCAction.Item: Confirm each is benign; close as false_positive.

TruePositive.Definition: A compromised user corroborated across surfaces.

SOCAction.Item: Reset the user + revoke tokens; isolate their endpoint; open IR; pull all surface timelines.

Misconfiguration.Definition: A special-purpose account with expected multi-product alerts.

SOCAction.Item: Confirm the account context; tune; document.

Phase.name: Immediate Actions (0-30 minutes)
Phase.Action: Reset the user + revoke tokens; isolate their endpoint.

Phase.name: Containment and Eradication (hours)
Phase.Action: Reset user; isolate endpoint; open IR; correlate the surfaces.

Phase.name: Recovery and Hardening (days)
Phase.Action: Enforce CA/MFA; ensure Defender enforcing across surfaces.

QualityChecks.Check: Cross-product correlation on user.name; Defender ingest lag ~26 min.

TruePositiveClosure.Item: User reset; endpoint isolated; surfaces correlated.
